svg.title: Five representative horse coat patterns
svg.desc: One chestnut horse shown as five teaching coats. Neither modeled pattern is the plain chestnut. Frame-overo keeps a colored topline and legs around white side patches. Leopard-complex is a pale coat with spots across the body. Fewspot is mostly white with only a few dark spots. Pintaloosa combines the frame patches and the leopard spots.

g.text: No frame and no leopard complex
Pale coat, spots over the body
Mostly white, only a few spots
